# Publisher's Note {.unnumbered}

This is the first of three physical volumes of *The Path of Many Arrows*. It contains Part I, *The First Archers*, including the Prologue that opens the journey. The three volumes form one work, while each is designed to be read, carried, and revised as a book in its own right.
